_weights._note: Merchants rank BELOW farmers and artisans in Confucian order, so w_commerce is negative: getting rich is not a route to status here, passing the examinations is. But alchemy and technical craft are far less likely to be called sorcery than in Rome.
_weights._note_eminence: Court factions and eunuch politics make eminence dangerous in much the same way, and the examination-literati class resents an outsider.
